name: Upload File
description: Uploads a file to the specified document. [See the documentation](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounting/invoices#upload-attachment)

configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: filePathOrUrl
configurable_props.label: File Path or URL
configurable_props.description: The file to upload. Provide either a file URL or a path to a file in the `/tmp` directory (for example, `/tmp/myFile.txt`)

configurable_props.name: documentType
configurable_props.label: Document Type
configurable_props.description: Document type of where the attachment will be sent to. This is used in as part of the Xero Account API endpoint where the request is sent against.

configurable_props.name: documentId
configurable_props.label: Document ID
configurable_props.description: Xero identifier of the document where the attachment will be sent to.
